children.name: text
children.label: Heading
children.default: Ship online orders from the best location

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.help_text: Optional. One or two sentences under the heading.
children.default: Whichever location routing picks, the order ships from there, and the OMS tracks it until it’s delivered. Try shipping one from a store below.

children.name: anchor_id
children.label: Anchor ID
children.help_text: Optional. Letters, numbers, dashes or underscores only. Lets other links jump to this section.

default.text: Ship online orders from the best location
default.description: Whichever location routing picks, the order ships from there, and the OMS tracks it until it’s delivered. Try shipping one from a store below.

name: points
label: Ship points
help_text: Three points above the demo. The icons stay in this order: warehouses, stores, same-day delivery.

default.title: Warehouses
default.text: Your warehouse keeps its WMS, ERP, or 3PL. The OMS gets fulfillment updates back and reroutes anything it can’t ship.

default.title: Stores
default.text: Store teams pick, pack, and ship from their own stock, and each store takes only as many orders a day as you allow.

default.title: Same-day delivery
default.text: A nearby store packs the order, and Shipt or DoorDash delivers it within hours.

children.name: title
children.label: Title
children.default: Ship an online order from a store

children.name: description
children.label: Description
children.default: Run one real order through HotWax, click by click, on the screens store associates use.

children.name: steps
children.label: Steps
children.help_text: The demo always has these four steps, in this order.

children.name: tab
children.label: Tab name
children.help_text: One or two words, shown in the step tabs above the demo.

children.name: text
children.label: Text
children.help_text: Shown on the start card on tablets and laptops.

default.title: Print a picklist
default.text: The store manager prints one picklist for open orders and assigns a picker.

default.title: Pack the order
default.text: The associate scans each item into the right box. The carrier and shipping method come from the order.

default.title: Print the slip and label
default.text: The packing slip and the carrier label print together.

default.title: Ship it
default.text: Mark the order shipped, and the tracking number goes to the customer and your eCommerce store.

children.name: note
children.label: Note
children.default: About a minute. Real order, real screens.
